greeting: I am {agent} from {company}. May we talk now?
ask_problem: Ask the caller to briefly describe their health problem.
ask_doctor: Which doctor would you like to see? Dr. Mehra, Dr. Khan, or Dr. Iyer?
ask_time: Which day and morning/evening would you like to come? (within next 7 days)
read_back: I have understood that {name} is {age} years old, with Dr. {doctor} at {appointment_time}. Is this correct?
fix_prompt: Ask which detail the caller wants to change or if they prefer not to book now.
booked: Your appointment with Dr. {doctor} at {appointment_time} is booked. Thank you.
emergency_line: This is an emergency, please go to the nearest hospital immediately.
human_line: Connecting you to clinic staff. Please hold.
report_line: For reports or medication information, I will connect you to reception.
cancel_not_allowed: Cancellation or rescheduling cannot be done over this call; please contact reception.
decide_doctor: Select the appropriate doctor based on problem and age, set {doctor}.
